display_long_description:
Uproar is a scary yet fun horror experience that combines the intensity of classic survival horror with the fast, playful movement of Gorilla Tag–style gameplay. Built around a pixelated PS1-era aesthetic, the game embraces low-resolution textures, crunchy sound design, and eerie lighting that perfectly captures the unsettling vibe of retro horror while keeping the action fresh and exciting.

Players move through a variety of creepy, atmospheric levels using freeform climbing, swinging, and wall-bouncing mechanics, giving a unique sense of speed and freedom rarely seen in horror games. While the world feels dark, broken, and haunted, the movement makes exploration feel fun and engaging, balancing fear with adrenaline.

Between terrifying encounters, players can relax in a fully stocked in-game shop where they can customize their character with cosmetics, making each run feel personal and giving a lighter, playful contrast to the chilling environments.

With its blend of retro horror visuals, fluid VR-inspired movement, and both scary and enjoyable moments, Dead Signal stands out as a horror game that doesn’t just try to scare you—it makes sure you’re having a good time while it does.
